defaultResult.kind: Public-outcome router holdout and counterfactual GPU reservation replay; not deployment measurements

learnedMinusStrong.scope: 95% paired percentile bootstrap over held-out questions, conditional on this fitted router, split and fixed random control; excludes training/seed uncertainty and dataset shift

learnedMinusExpectedRandom.scope: 95% paired percentile bootstrap over questions versus the exact matched-quota random expectation; quota and fitted router held fixed. Does not include fitting, random-allocation or dataset-shift uncertainty.

randomSeedVariation.scope: Descriptive variation over all predeclared matched-budget random seeds; not a confidence interval

routing.scope: Retrospective within-GSM8K holdout. Labels are cached model outcomes; no new LLM inference. All test results are now inspectable and must not be reused for further tuning as untouched data.
